# Numbers audit (generated by `scripts/audit_numbers.py`)

Tables in README.md, reports/test_summary.md and reports/validation_summary.md were compared with values recomputed from the result files (test metrics in `reports/tables/test_results.jsonl`, validation numbers in the generated validation reports, paired differences recomputed from the saved predictions). **181 of 181 checks passed, 0 failed.**

## Part 1: errors found and fixed, and what was checked by hand

**Errors found and corrected in the hand-written documents (audit of 2026-10-16)**
1. `reports/test_summary.md`: the festival sentence still said error around festivals was "about twice the average for every model"; the correct statement is 1.3-1.7 times the overall error for XGBoost at 6-48 h (not elevated at 1 h) and 1.7-1.9 times for the LSTMs and ridge at 48 h. (A fix made earlier had not been applied because the command that carried it failed.)
2. `reports/test_summary.md`: a stale caveat said the rolling-origin check was still to be done; it has been done.
3. `reports/test_summary.md`: skill ranges against the best naive baseline were quoted as "61-64%" (LSTMs, 1 h) and "41-50%" (6 h); recomputed values are 62-64% and 41-49%.
4. `reports/test_summary.md` and `reports/research_question_answers.md`: festival error ratio for LSTMs and ridge at 48 h stated as 1.7-1.8 times, recomputed 1.7-1.9.
5. `reports/research_question_answers.md`: one bullet said the LSTM was given only conformal intervals (no quantile head) while the next bullet reported the LSTM quantile head results; corrected.
6. `reports/research_question_answers.md`: a limitation said scenario C was not run; it was run for temperature only; corrected.
7. `reports/research_question_answers.md`: LSTM quantile training time stated as about 17 minutes (972 s = about 16); the wording of the rolling-fold count was made precise (two folds on 2023 plus the main split).
8. `reports/validation_summary.md`: LSTM inference cost stated as "10-30 times more per sample"; recomputed from the logs it is 11 to 20 times; a sentence saying the test period had not been used was marked as written before the test run.
9. Earlier in the project (caught while writing, before the audit): a full-data baseline value for XGBoost at 6 h that had been quoted without being looked up, a skill-range sentence, and a 5-20 times cost range (recomputed as 4 to 45 times).

**Checked by hand against the generated reports (no script)**
- Subset errors (festival windows, holidays, seasons) in `reports/test_results.md`; interval coverage, widths and interval scores in `reports/uncertainty.md` (all ranges quoted for XGBoost S4 and the LSTM quantile head); rolling-origin statements in `reports/rolling_origin.md`; solar and demand range statistics in `reports/ablation_paired.md`; daily-study numbers in `reports/regional_daily_study_test.md`; extension intervals in `reports/extensions_xgb_test.md`.
- Efficiency figures recomputed from the jsonl logs (refit seconds, tuning minutes per trial, model sizes, parameter counts, inference per sample).
- The headline numbers repeated in `docs/project_plan.md` ("Test results" line, 20 of 20 values) match `reports/tables/test_results.jsonl`.

**Not covered by this audit**: figures inside `docs/experiment_protocol.md` (deviation log), `reports/data_dictionary.md`, the exploratory-analysis report, the cleaning and canonical-dataset logs (generated by scripts), and `docs/novelty_assessment.md` (literature statements are from search summaries, not verified papers).
